caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron fence enclosing a rectangular stone structure. The fence has vertical bars with pointed finials on top, and the central gate features a symmetrical heart-shaped scrollwork design in the middle. At the corners of the fence, there are decorative urn-shaped finials on top of the posts. Above the gate, there is a decorative iron element featuring a vertical spike and horizontal leaf-like forms radiating outward. The enclosure sits on and is surrounded by flat, angular stone platforms or steps. The entire scene is rendered in shades of brown and beige, giving it a monochromatic appearance. The background is simple and lightly shaded, providing contrast to the detailed fence and stonework in the foreground.
title: Iron Gate and Fence
